description: §5.2 executable-sink rule (S456) controls: interpolation into a relative URL path, after a fixed `https:` or `mailto:` scheme, and a quoted event attribute with NO `${…}` all compile and render.
rationale: §5.2 executable-sink rule refuses only an executable sink: an event attribute WITH `${…}`, `srcdoc` with `${…}`, or a URL whose LITERAL scheme is not one of `http:` / `https:` / `mailto:` / `tel:`. A scheme written literally cannot be changed by the interpolation that follows its `:`. A quoted event attribute with no `${…}` stays a static string (§5.2 rule 1).
